features: EVERYDAY PRINTING SOLUTION: Keep everyday printing practical with Splashjet 003 Compatible Refill Ink for selected Epson EcoTank ink tank printers. Suitable for home, office, educational and business use, including documents, assignments, invoices and reports.

COST-EFFECTIVE PRINTING: A practical ink refill solution for regular printing requirements. Ideal for students, home users, offices and businesses printing homework, reports, invoices and routine business records while managing printing expenses.

WATER-BASED INK FORMULATION: Features a water-based ink formulation designed for compatible refillable ink tank printers. The bottle format supports convenient ink replenishment. Use the recommended refilling procedure to help prevent spills and ensure proper handling.

WIDE PRINTER COMPATIBILITY: Compatible with selected Epson printer models, including L3250, L3210, L3150, L3110, L3100, L3101, L3111, L3115, L3116, L3118, L3119, L3151, L3152, L3156, L3158, L3211, L3215, L3216, L3350, L3352, L3310, L3360, L3560, L4150, L4158, L4160, L4168, L4260, L5190, L6160, L6161, L6168, L6170, L6171, L6178, L6190, L6191, L6198, L1110 and L1350. Verify your printer model and required ink series before purchase.

HIGH PAGE YIELD: Approximate yield of up to 4,700 pages in Black and 7,500 pages in Colour at 5% page coverage, subject to the applicable ink quantity and testing conditions. Actual yield varies with document coverage, printer settings and usage. Page-yield figures should be used only when supported by testing for this Splashjet ink product.
